rows.notes: intent accuracy on 12 held-out tickets (imitation/SFT baseline)

intent accuracy on 12 held-out tickets; reward-optimized (correctness reward via eval-protocol evaluator), LoRA r16, 5 epochs; delta +16.7 pts vs SFT. RFT fixed the exact 2 boundary cases SFT missed (t11 billing, t12 technical -> both SFT-misrouted to account). 100% is one sample on 12 tickets and nondeterministic; robust claim is RFT > SFT. RFT reward curve climbed 0.66->0.85.
